title: Recall issued for H-E-B's 'Backyard BBQ' chop salad kit due to potentially undeclared nuts, FDA says - ABC13 Houston
text:
Recall issued for H-E-B's 'Backyard BBQ' chop salad kit due to potentially undeclared nuts, FDA says - ABC13 Houston 
 24/7 Live Houston Southwest Southeast Northwest Northeast Product Recalls 
 Recall issued for H-E-B's 'Backyard BBQ' chop salad kit due to potentially undeclared nuts, FDA says 
 Watch Eyewitness News and ABC13 originals around the clock Wednesday, October 28, 2026 3:10PM Share HOUSTON, Texas (KTRK) -- Taylor Farms has recalled a salad kit sold at H-E-B because it may contain undeclared ingredients that could cause allergic reactions, according to the FDA.
 The company is recalling the H-E-B "Backyard BBQ" chop salad kit due to the potential presence of undeclared soy and almonds. The product was sold at H-E-B stores across Texas and has a "Best If Used By" date of Oct. 30 and the UPC code of 041220300457.
 The FDA said people who have sensitivity or allergy to soy and tree nuts, like almonds, may be at risk of a serious adverse reaction if they consume this product.
 Officials said that at this time, there have been no reported adverse reactions to this product.
